title: 地学基礎実験
subtitle: Basic Experiments in Geoscience
educationalGoal: Learn the use of basic experimental tools correctly and what is necessary for safety throughout basic experiments in geoscience. Learn data analysis of the experimental results using a computer. Plan and conduct geological experiments, and Prepare a report describing the experimental method and results. Learn how to achieve high educational effects in geological experiments when geological experiments conduct.
advice: This course is intended for applicants for teachers of science in junior high school or high school. Learn the safety training, the use of experimental tools and instruments correctly, and the knowledge of data analysis using a computer throughout basic experiments in geoscience for junior high school and high school. Conduct field works such as minerals sampling and stratum observation in addition to indoor experiments. Fieldwork will be conduct on Saturday in April. The order of the experiments may change due to the weather or schedule, check the Student Portal carefully.
books: Textbook: Chigaku Kiso Jikkenn (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing) Reference book: Mizu no Bunseki (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Chishitsu Chousa to Chishichizu (Asakura Shoten Publishing), Tenkizu no Mikata Tebiki (Kuraimu Publishing), Ganseki Kaseki no Kenbikyou Kansatsu (Chijin Shokan Publishing), Tenkizu no Kakikata Tebiki Saihan (Kuraimu Kishou Tosho Shuppan Publising)
requiredKnowledge: It is necessary to a deeper understanding than what you teach in order to teach geological experiments in Junior high school and High school. In order to require knowledge of geoscience in the high school field, review the geoscience field of high school. In this class, learn useful knowledge for teaching geoscience through the experiments.

activityGoals.body: Read the textbook, and conduct the experiment using the equipments and experimental tools properly.
Discuss and evaluate the results properly.
Prepare the experiments useful for understanding in geoscience field, and teach the experiments.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Understand the natural environment accurately, and plan necessary experiments for education. 2. Read the instruction, and plan and conduct the experiments safely yourself. 3. Evaluate and discuss properly the results using a computer.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Understand the natural environment, and plan necessary experiments for education by referring to textbooks, etc. 2. Read the instruction, and plan and conduct the experiments safely. 3. Evaluate and discuss the results using a computer.

lessons.content: Course outline Significance of geological experiments in science education Safety training
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Summarize safety rules concerning geological experiments. Assignment: Prepare an report about the lecture.

lessons.content: Fieldwork - Mine and Museum tour - Collecting rocks
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Summarize how to observe stratum and minerals. Assignment: Prepare an report about minerals.

lessons.content: Observation and characterization of minerals(1) - Sample preparation - Surface observation by SEM - Mineral analysis using XRF and XRD
Observation and characterization of minerals(2) - Streak test - Measurement of Mohs hardness
lessons.assignments: Readings: Chapter 2, Section 2.2 Complete a Lab report.

lessons.content: Atmosphere and Humidity - Boyle's law - Charles' law - partial pressure - saturation vapor pressure
lessons.assignments: Readings: Chapter 3 Complete a Lab report.

lessons.content: Surface weather map analysis - Plotting a surface weather charts - Basic weather forecasting - Weather observation
lessons.assignments: Readings: Chapter 4 Complete two surface weather charts and a Lab report.

lessons.content: Water analysis - Pretreatment of natural water samples - Determination of fluoride in spring water and groundwater samples
lessons.assignments: Readings: Chapter 5 Complete a Lab report.

lessons.content: Overall review -necessity of geological experiments, and safety training- Self-evaluation Day
lessons.assignments: Check your mistakes and review your weakness.
